en: Black‑and‑white view along a broad, clean street bordered by substantial multi‑storey buildings in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century European historicist style. On the left stands a large corner block with ornate gables, turrets, and a steep tiled roof; people are visible looking out from the open windows. On the right are lower institutional‑looking buildings with hip roofs and a domed pavilion in the mid‑distance. A few pedestrians walk along the street and sidewalks; there are no cars, only open space and simple fencing in the foreground. The sky is blank and overexposed, and the image has the framing and proportions typical of an old postcard or plate photograph.
